summary: Ledger notes after removing inferred counts.

ledger.contains: PM Decree 1321/2022 (dated 2022-04-06; Gazette No. 13 bis (c) of 2022-04-06, pp. 3-4) granting Egyptian nationality: preamble cites Law 26/1975, Investment Law 72/2017 and PM Decrees 3099/2019 and 647/2020 (investment programme); Art. 1 lists 9 named people with nationality, place and date of birth (Syrian 5, Palestinian 3, Lebanese 1); Art. 2 publication. The total was already recorded; nationality split added. Names, birthplaces and birth dates are personal data and not recorded; no amounts or routes are given. Counts of persons naturalised (in total and by nationality) are not recorded: the decree prints an unnumbered list of names with no total, so any count would be a tally by us (METHODOLOGY.md decision 2, 'inferred').
